sides.label: Majority side
sides.detail: Two replicas can communicate and retain the current authority.

sides.label: Isolated side
sides.detail: One healthy replica cannot reach the other two replicas.

operations.label: Read inventory
operations.detail: Ask for the current value of inventory:sku-42.

operations.label: Reserve one item
operations.detail: Attempt a mutation that must not oversell inventory.

policies.label: Protect one current order
policies.detail: Require authority from the communicating majority and reject operations that cannot prove it.

policies.label: Keep both sides responsive
policies.detail: Let each side answer from local state and reconcile divergent writes after communication returns.
